impact.claims: Prep11 public discovery, eight public source scopes, five baseline areas, two context updates; Advisor three bounded decisions and dependency gates.
impact.interfaces: Existing Prep11 and Advisor views; no new tools, endpoints or customer data collection.
impact.exports: Existing screen/PDF/offline HTML/shared/invalid routes; preserve all caveats and individual claim dates.
impact.owners: Existing Release Watch and independent Guidance Audit; ES and CSP owners retain their scoped authority.
impact.privacy: Public assessed sources only; existing local Advisor and read-only Ripple boundaries preserved.
impact.authority: Approved implementation and verified Prep11 corrections/publication; saved cadence and existing permissions must remain intact.
impact.budgets: No new paid service, timer, budget or cap increase. Unmeasured tokens, cost and resource use stay null.
impact.schedules: No cadence, timing mode, timezone, enabled state or notification change authorized.

authorization.evidence: Chris approved the proposed Prep11/Advisor pilot and constitution with “Yes”; separately authorized verified 11.x corrections and existing-watch amendments without schedule changes.
authorization.source: Owner-approved November 2, 2026 Prep11/Advisor pilot and public constitution scope.

savedTasks.readbackEvidence: Native automations.peek read before prompt-only automations.update, then independent peek readback. Full original prompt retained as prefix; only prompt and updated_at differed in exposed saved object. No schedule, timezone, timing mode, enabled state, title or conversation change. Notification/model/permission controls are not exposed by this connector and were omitted from mutation; no new authority was added.

firstExecution.evidence: Native run_now succeeded and returned inline_run with the saved amended prompt. The inline prompt was executed in this turn.
